label: Reason or cause of existence
resolution: A stipulated explanatory reason for a world-relative existence fact (DEF-PSR-REASON) is not interchangeable with a distinct efficient cause of the existing individual (DEF-PSR-EXTERNAL-CAUSE). The first certified case satisfies existence-PSR while not every existent has a distinct existing cause (its concrete witness has no causes at all, but the certified type exposes only the failure of EveryExistentExternallyCaused). Whether an intrinsic reason counts as a genuinely sufficient metaphysical explanation remains open, so this result establishes formal non-entailment rather than metaphysical success.
